description: This file contains utility functions for extracting and transforming metadata related to Opik payload building and trace/span information, as well as normalizing provider names within a software project. It provides functions for processing metadata, handling proxy headers, and extracting tracing identifiers, primarily for use in tracing, logging, and ensuring consistent metadata formatting in the context of Opik integrations.

methods.name: Optional[str] normalize_provider_name(provider: Optional[str])
methods.description: Normalizes LiteLLM provider names to standardized string names based on a predefined mapping.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_opik_metadata( litellm_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Extracts and merges Opik-specific metadata from provided metadata dictionaries.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] extract_span_identifiers( current_span_data: Any, )
methods.description: Extracts trace_id and parent_span_id from span data, which can be in different formats.

methods.name: List[str] extract_tags( opik_metadata: Dict[str, Any], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Builds a list of tags from Opik metadata and optionally includes a custom LLM provider name.

methods.name: Tuple[str,List[str],Optional[str]] apply_proxy_header_overrides( project_name: str, tags: List[str], thread_id: Optional[str], proxy_headers: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Overrides project name, tags, and thread ID based on proxy request headers with prefix 'opik_'.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_and_build_metadata( opik_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_object: Dict[str, Any], litellm_kwargs: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Constructs a comprehensive metadata dictionary combining Opik metadata, logging info, and cost data for traces/spans.

ctags.signature: ( opik_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_object: Dict[str, Any], litellm_kwargs: Dict[str, Any], )

ctags.signature: ( litellm_metadata: Dict[str, Any], standard_logging_metadata: Dict[str, Any], )
